answer.text: SEBI's 2023 Online Dispute Resolution system for intermediary-client disputes

explanation.text: The Logic: SMART ODR launched 2023: online mediation/arbitration for SEBI-regulated intermediaries (including PMS). The Trap: It IS for PMS; not exchange-specific. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A, XXI-B. Manager's Pro-Tip: Inform clients of SMART ODR in the MITC — it's cheaper/faster than civil court.
